_comment: GitLab username -> OM Chat handle. A person with no entry is still scored but never picked, because a kudos post that cannot tag them reaches nobody. QAs are NOT listed here: they are read live from the space's @QA role on every run.
_names_comment: GitLab username -> what teammates call them, for the post's prose. GitLab profile names are often family-name-first ('Ji Chang' is CJ), so the writer never takes a name from GitLab; anyone missing here is called by @handle.
_exclude_comment: Never picked, whatever their score. Kyle by request (2026-10-12).
